scan.reason: No composite rule crossed the candidate threshold; this is not proof of authorship or overall design quality.

review.policy: Review visible page/component context; never infer AI authorship from a candidate.

limitations: Static analysis sees only literal JSX/HTML classes and resolvable local CSS class blocks.
Runtime composition, screenshots, visual prominence, and product intent require agent review.
A clean result is not a design-system audit and does not establish who or what authored the code.
